results.detail: Verified. scopeNote_he: there is one connection manager [psql] (psql/ALTSHULER_MSCRM, DTSX:4-6) and no DTS:Configuration. Component types are OLEDBSource, Lookup, ConditionalSplit, DerivedColumn, UnionAll and ManagedComponentHost only, with one ScriptTask, so there is no SQL DML. ServerName and OrganizationName come from gen_etlvariable (DTSX:8329; ReadWriteVariables User::OrganizationName,User::ServerName). The link-status labels match the SQL comments (DTSX:10055, 11969, 13889, 15807, 17699) and VALID = 2 (DTSX:742, 3803). The gen_poaoperator meanings are hedged. summary_he matches the order and filters. Two problems. (1) Ownership of the unqualified columns in the HAVING / GROUP BY is not argued. 'count(gen_poaaccountoperatorid)' and 'group by gen_poaoperatorid' are unqualified in a 2-table query (gen_poaoperator JOIN gen_poaaccountoperator). It must be labelled השערה (from the split's name), or stated as 'gen_applypoa = 1'.

results.detail: Units [1]-[8] and [10] are correct (DTSX:10053-10055, 9973; main.cs:122-130, 139-163). Unit [9] code facts are correct.
